metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the hunting query 'HUN - Mailbox Forwarding to External Domain'

properties.displayName: HUN - Mailbox Forwarding to External Domain
properties.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Operation in ("Set-Mailbox","Set-ForwardingAddress")
// Parameters is a dynamic array of {"Name","Value"} objects (capitalised keys).
// Expand it and read the parameters by name instead of regex-scanning a string
// rendering of the array — the regex form breaks silently if Microsoft changes
// the serialisation or parameter ordering.
| mv-expand p = Parameters
| extend PName = tostring(p.Name), PValue = tostring(p.Value)
| where PName in ("ForwardingSmtpAddress", "ForwardingAddress", "DeliverToMailboxAndForward")
| summarize Params = make_bag(bag_pack(PName, PValue)) by TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, OfficeObjectId
| extend ForwardSmtp = tostring(Params.ForwardingSmtpAddress)
| extend ForwardAddr = tostring(Params.ForwardingAddress)
// ForwardingSmtpAddress values can arrive as "smtp:user@domain.com" and
// ForwardingAddress as a proxy address ("SMTP:user@domain.com") or a DN, so
// strip the protocol prefix and stray quote characters before parsing.
| extend RawTarget = tostring(coalesce(ForwardSmtp, ForwardAddr))
| extend Target = replace_regex(RawTarget, @"(?i)^\s*smtp:", "")
| extend Target = trim(@" \t", replace_string(Target, "\"", ""))
| where isnotempty(Target)
| extend TargetDomain = tolower(tostring(split(Target, "@")[1]))
| extend UserDomain = tolower(tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]))
| where isnotempty(TargetDomain) and TargetDomain != UserDomain
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Target, TargetDomain, ClientIP, Operation, Params

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hypothesis - BEC actors set mailbox-level forwarding (Set-Mailbox -ForwardingSmtpAddress) to silently mirror inbound mail to an attacker address. Surface every change in 14 days where the destination domain differs from the tenant's primary
